title: Apply for a bus driver authority
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a bus driver authority from Transport for NSW (TfNSW) to drive a public passenger bus or coach that seats 13 or more people.
intro:
To drive a public passenger bus or coach that seats 13 or more people, you need to have a bus driver authority from Transport for NSW (TfNSW).

To determine your eligibility for an authority, and assess your application, TfNSW requires specific documentation from you before you apply, otherwise the processing of your application could be slowed down.

You can apply for a bus driver authority online.
who_can_apply: Hold a current Australian driver licence.
Be aged 20 years or over, and have held a full (unrestricted) Australian driver licence for 12 months in the last 2 years.
Be aged 25 years or over, and have held a safe driver status for at least 3 of the last 4 years.
Be a fit and proper person to hold a bus driver authority.
Apply under Mutual Recognition (e.g., holders of a New Zealand (NZ) bus driver authority).
Work temporarily in NSW under Automatic Mutual Recognition (AMR).
what_you_need: A commercial medical assessment (completed no more than 6 months prior).
A National Police check issued no more than 3 months prior to the application.
Evidence of successfully completing the required bus driver training course.
A copy of your driver licence front and back (scanned as a PDF).
A secondary proof of identity document (if you hold an interstate driver licence).
If you have held an interstate or overseas driver licence in the last 5 years, you need a copy of your licence history and traffic record from the relevant authority for each licence held.

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Apply online' button.Note: You cannot save and resume your application once you have started.

more_info.text: The fee waiver for new Bus Driver Authority applications has been extended for a further 12 months, until 31 July 2026. The fee waiver was introduced on 1 August 2023 by the NSW Government as part of efforts to boost bus driver numbers in NSW.

Note: If TfNSW has not updated or received your commercial medical assessment, you will get a warning that your application will be refused if you proceed with submitting your application online. You can contact 02 8848 8700 (option 4) to check the status of your medical assessment.

faqs.q: When does the Experienced Driver Recognition (EDR) Scheme finish?
faqs.a: The Experienced Driver Recognition (EDR) Scheme will finish on 31 January 2026.

faqs.q: Are overseas licences issued under the Recognition Licence Scheme (RLS) still accepted?
faqs.a: Yes, the Recognition Licence Scheme (RLS) is unchanged, and overseas licences issued under the RLS will continue to be accepted for tenure.

faqs.q: What is required to apply for a Bus Driver Authority?
faqs.a: You must have a current Australian driver licence, be aged 20 or over (with specific licence holding requirements), and meet other criteria such as being medically fit and a fit and proper person.
